title: flyte-eks add-on configuration
description: Per-deployment configuration merged into the flyte-eks wrapper chart. CloudFormation (Artifact B) supplies these values via AWS::EKS::Addon ConfigurationValues; the helm-fallback path receives the identical document from scripts/render-config.sh. All keys are namespaced under `flyteBinary`, the Chart.yaml alias for the flyte-binary subchart that receives them. The data-offload prefix (`flyte-core-components.runs.storagePrefix`) and the ingress annotation blocks are always supplied by CloudFormation rather than by hand, and pass through additionalProperties rather than being declared here.

configuration.description: Backend configuration: external database and object store.

database.description: External PostgreSQL connection. flyte-binary v2 reads the connection from database.postgres.* (the flat database.* keys are v1 and ignored). The password is never passed here — it is mounted into the pod from the flyte-db-credentials Kubernetes Secret, which must exist in the add-on namespace before install.

options.description: Connection options appended to the DSN.

metadataContainer.description: S3 bucket for Flyte metadata (the provisioned bucket). v2 has no separate userDataContainer.

region.description: AWS region of the S3 bucket, e.g. us-east-1.

authType.description: Fixed to iam — credentials come from the EKS Pod Identity role. Static keys are rejected.

ingress.description: ALB ingress for the Flyte API and web console.

create.description: Create Ingress resources. Requires the AWS Load Balancer Controller.

host.description: Public hostname, e.g. flyte.example.com (prod mode only).

nodeSelector.description: Node labels the Flyte backend pods must match.

tolerations.description: Tolerations applied to the Flyte backend pods.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for the Flyte backend pods.

podLabels.description: Additional Kubernetes labels applied to the Flyte backend pods.

podAnnotations.description: Additional Kubernetes annotations applied to the Flyte backend pods.

resources.description: CPU and memory requests and limits for the Flyte backend container.
